tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand Blue (C78 M73 Y0 K0). The logo badge, big colour fields, primary actions. White text on it 6.1:1, lime text 5.0:1.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Brand Lime (C18 M0 Y85 K0). INFINITY in the logo, the spark, highlights and date pills. Black text on it 17:1. Never as text on white or light grey (1.1:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand White. VIBES in the logo, page ground in light theme, text on blue.

tokens.name: light-grey
tokens.usage: Brand Light Grey (K10). Quiet panels, dividers, table stripes on white.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand Black. Text on white, lime and light grey; page ground in dark theme; the black-and-white logo.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on surface. Dark value is a neutral step, not a brand colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-subtle (16:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on surface and surface-subtle (6.7:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only, not control outlines.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button and link fills, both themes. Pair with on-action.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Date pills, tags, sparks. Pair with on-highlight.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Destination names and heroes. Uppercase, Galano Grotesque Heavy.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles, as in the guidelines (THE LOGO / ANATOMY).

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Jeep safari through the canyons, snorkelling at the Blue Hole.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Eyebrows, footers and taglines: uppercase, wide tracking, as in the guidelines.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Date cards and photo cards: rounded, like the badge.
